name: Darkroom
summary: A darkroom 404 page: frame 404 never developed, so you pick a frame and watch it print, develop and dry
about: A full not-found page for a photo studio, with prints swinging on a drying line, a contact sheet of negatives to search and a bench with an enlarger, three trays and a ticking timer. Pick a frame and the paper is exposed, rocked in the developer until the picture slowly appears, moved through stop and fix, then pegged on the line with a link.
how: The headline develops like a print while the photos drop onto the line and swing
Type in Find a frame and press Print it, or press any negative on the contact sheet
Watch the steps: expose, develop, stop, fix, then the print hangs on the line with its link
Swipe your pointer across the line to make the prints swing, or tap the blank print three times
The safelight button switches between room lights and a red darkroom; it plays a demo until you take over
